Fact Sheet
Linking 
theory with 
practice
Theory is a beautiful thing, but we also put emphasis on student motivation, entrepreneurial spirit and transfer 
of knowledge. We have our own entrepreneurial and innovation ecosystem ContriBUTe, where we support 
innovation and knowledge. At our university students and faculties generate thousands of great ideas that can 
make the world better and more sustainable place to live. That’s why we actively connect the authors of 
promising research discoveries with industrial partners.
Brno University of Technology
Research 
responding 
to current 
challenges
In our research we focus on the development of new technologies that shape the future such as semiconductor 
design and production, cybersecurity and the use of AI, Industry 4.0, aerospace and automotive engineering. 
We care deeply about the environment and sustainability too. We develop solutions in battery and 
energy accumulation, environmental engineering, and circular economy. However, our scope is much bigger 
as our strategic focus areas expand as far as to the ﬁelds of biomedical engineering, and nuclear power 
engineering too.
Safe and 
sound in the 
heart of 
Europe
According to the Global Peace Index 2024, the Czech Republic ranks among TOP 12 safest countries worldwide, 
it goes without saying the same applies to Brno. Students generally appreciate Brno’s tolerance, ease of getting 
around, aﬀordability, and also a large and friendly student community. There’s something for everyone: concerts, 
theatres, parties, exhibitions, UNESCO architecture and rich history are all at your ﬁngertips. The unique 
atmosphere simply must be experienced in person.
University 
Rankings
Top-notch
University
In recent years, BUT has been ranked in all 3 major world rankings of the highest quality universities:
QS world University Rankings, Times Higher Education (THE) and in the prestigious 
ARWU ranking – a Shanghai Ranking focused primarily on scientiﬁc research.
Brno University of Technology is the leading technical university in the Czech Republic. We provide education in 
a full spectrum of technical disciplines, including civil, mechanical, and electrical engineering, chemistry, and 
information technology, as well as business and management, economics, architecture, and ﬁne arts. As the 
fourth largest university in the country, we are one of the pillars of higher education and research in the country.
